patch_description: Replace the greedy "replicate the currently-heaviest-per-replica expert" loop in `replicate_experts` with a proportional largest-remainder allocation of the redundant expert slots. This spreads replicas across experts according to their relative load (instead of stacking replicas on the single hottest expert repeatedly), which directly reduces the variance of per-replica loads and hence improves expert-level balancedness. Additionally, the physical replicas are emitted in descending per-replica-load order, which makes the subsequent LPT-style `balanced_packing` (Step 3 in the hierarchical rebalancer) pack the heaviest replicas first — improving GPU-level balancedness too. The loop count drops from `num_redundant` full-tensor argmax passes to a single top-k pass plus a small per-row Python loop, so it is also faster.
